allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Nadine and Manu are two mad women, as tidy as can be, almost perfectionists. They have several things in common: extreme sex, drugs, beer and the trigger. They find the solution to their problems with guns and beware to those who dare to get in their way!

facts.title: Baise-moi

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When two perfectionists decide firearms are the only answer to their grievances, how far does their volatile crusade go?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Bonded by drugs, sex, and meticulous habits, Nadine and Manu navigate a volatile reality where every obstacle is met with gunfire in Coralie Trinh Thi and Virginie Despentes' French crime thriller.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Heavy, rapid, and fiercely tense; an intense solo watch defined by uncompromising grit and danger.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: At a lean 77 minutes, it delivers an abrasive, uncompromising crime thriller driven by lethal impulse and raw defiance, bypassing conventional storytelling limits.
